description: Capital allocation history — Where a US-listed company's cash went, from its 10-K XBRL cash-flow facts: operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow, acquisitions, buybacks, dividends, debt issued and repaid, R&D and stock comp for up to 10 fiscal years, yearly deployment mix, cumulative shares and a style label (REINVESTOR / ACQUIRER / SHAREHOLDER_RETURNER / DELEVERAGER / BALANCED) plus flags such as debt-funded buybacks or buybacks that mostly offset dilution. ticker= (or cik=), optional years= 2-10 (default 5). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_capital_allocation
